invariants: W73 extends the landed W68 state machine and artifacts; it does not create a second Factory.
Production Run facts remain local and file-first; Hub receives only explicit W74c evidence projections.
Model, Provider, Harness, Seat, Capability and Executor remain distinct identities.
W82 compiles organizations and execution plans; W73 owns runtime state and Production Run facts.
W72 Registry describes providers and capabilities; it neither schedules nor executes them.
No Overall Score, hidden AUTO router, automatic promotion or automatic method mutation is permitted.
W73f adds local versioned economics, metrics, formulas, evaluations and Pareto facts only; W73g protocol assets, W73h soak and public Hub/Promotion remain excluded.

items.name: 回炉五件套

currentEvidence.claim: machine and point findings already produce bounded repair orders
non-convergence already returns to skeleton instead of looping forever
a single production unit can already be retried

items.gap: No normalized rework stage, reason code, lineage, affected-artifact set or cross-project query contract.
items.decision: Extend existing W68 repair artifacts into run-linked rework records; do not replace the review loop.

items.name: 统一导入消化管线

currentEvidence.claim: existing format entry points are heterogeneous and were only inventoried

items.gap: No unified source registration, layering, chunking, conflict policy or material-zone pipeline.
items.decision: Keep out of W73; W73 may consume explicit AssetEnvelope references after W74a exists.

items.name: 幻锚防线

currentEvidence.claim: deterministic findings already block unsupported draft conditions
constant and window anchors already constrain generation

items.gap: No shared hallucinated-anchor taxonomy, source evidence requirement, dead-proposal revival scan or run-level finding lineage.
items.decision: Add evidence-bearing findings to the existing review path; W70 may later consume them but is not a W73 prerequisite.

items.name: 审理工艺升级

currentEvidence.claim: M2 point review, M4/M5 review, objection, answer and M6 verdict are implemented
the four-gate rule is a named protocol invariant

items.gap: Only calibration, defect-spectrum evolution and integrated recovery evidence remain.
items.decision: Preserve as the W73 review kernel and use it as a compatibility gate.

items.name: 审计旗语与团队纪律

currentEvidence.claim: protected content and cited findings already constrain repair
seven operational health metrics already exist

items.gap: No independent audit-flag lifecycle, ownership, resolution evidence, expiration or organizational discipline registry.
items.decision: Model audit flags as run-linked findings and resolutions, not as a second review engine.

items.name: 岗前培训与持证上岗

currentEvidence.claim: role routing exists but does not constitute qualification

items.gap: No course, probe pack, qualification result, certificate level, expiry or assignment gate.
items.decision: Introduce inspectable qualification records and explicit gates; never infer certification from provider connection or model name.

items.name: 联合调度器

currentEvidence.claim: bounded concurrency worker pool already schedules current tasks
user-controlled concurrency 1-4 already exists

items.gap: No joint choice over capability, qualification, seat health, budget, priority, backpressure and recovery state.
items.decision: Build only after Run identity and qualification facts exist; retain manual override and explain every AUTO proposal.

items.name: 声明式绘图与图形工件

currentEvidence.claim: a safe external capability protocol exists but no drawing runtime is connected

items.gap: No Factory-native graphical artifact contract or executing drawing capability.
items.decision: Keep as a future capability/provider concern; W73 records references and results but does not build an editor or tool clone.

items.name: 计算委托

currentEvidence.claim: deterministic arithmetic recheck and ten-times error sniff are implemented

items.gap: No generic calculator or solver capability selection, execution provenance or typed output contract.
items.decision: W73 may schedule a registered deterministic capability after W79 supplies it; it must not ask a model to impersonate a solver.

items.name: 弹性编制

currentEvidence.claim: role-specific provider/model routing exists
review ritual can already degrade under a budget profile

items.gap: No explicit candidate set or staffing decision across capability, cost, risk, qualification and health.
items.decision: Produce an explainable staffing proposal over distinct Seat and Executor identities; user authority remains final.

items.name: 厂花与产品人格呈现

currentEvidence.claim: Style Studio is an adjacent style asset, not a product-persona system

items.gap: No formal persona asset, authority boundary, disclosure rule or product-level presentation contract.
items.decision: Keep discussion-stage and route product-persona work to W64; it is not a W73 seal gate.

items.name: 完整成本核算

currentEvidence.claim: review token budget and hard stop already exist
per-unit token totals are already persisted
estimate, provider reported, settled actual and unknown facts are strictly separated
currency, effective dates and price-table versions have a frozen local schema

items.gap: The protocol is landed, but the current W68 adapter has no trustworthy provider-reported usage, settled invoice or quota sample; monetary actual coverage therefore remains UNKNOWN.
items.decision: Keep W68 character-derived tokens as estimate, accept reported or settled facts only with versioned source evidence, and never fabricate actual cost.

items.name: 岗位 KPI 与系统健康

currentEvidence.claim: seven trend metrics already summarize review events
versioned KPI definitions are constrained to advisory system-health use
local evaluation context can attribute workflow, seat, executor, provider, model and defect class

items.gap: Definitions, attribution and anti-Goodhart constraints are landed; real rolling samples remain sparse and no KPI may be treated as a seat verdict.
items.decision: Retain health trends as advisory local evidence and prohibit metric targets from automatically punishing seats or rewriting gates/methods.

items.name: 本地模型测评中心

currentEvidence.claim: the required local evidence chain and public projection boundary are designed
versioned local evaluations recompute from drillable samples and preserve prior outputs
transparent non-dominated views exist without a one-number ranking

items.gap: ProductionRun, MetricDefinition, Formula, local scorecards and Pareto are landed; matched governance amplification and WorkerProfile ranking remain invalid until enough real samples exist.
items.decision: Keep evaluation local and replayable, report UNKNOWN or insufficient sample truthfully, and leave public records to W74c→W69j/k/l without one-number ranking.

items.name: 正式流程图与过程图资产

currentEvidence.claim: Factory Desk displays production artifacts but is not a reusable process-graph definition

items.gap: No queryable, versioned process-graph asset with step, gate, artifact and recovery references.
items.decision: Freeze a protocol asset and projection only; W82 later owns compiled organization graphs and W79 owns external rendering.

items.name: 任务委托

currentEvidence.claim: closed-card, bounded multi-step delegation exists in-process
agent execution is bounded and recorded

items.gap: No real external HarnessAdapter session supplies lifecycle, cancellation and result provenance.
items.decision: Internal delegation can adopt Run facts; external Agent execution remains gated on W66 real adapters and must not be simulated by Provider routing.

items.name: 导演表

currentEvidence.claim: director responsibilities belong to explicit plan, authority and artifact relationships

items.gap: No versioned showrunner/director protocol asset or explicit decision/exception handoff.
items.decision: Define a protocol asset consumed by Factory Desk; do not create a new standalone module shell.

items.name: 贡献者与产品人格手册

currentEvidence.claim: style assets are an adjacent implementation precursor
runtime role cards are not a contributor manual

items.gap: No formal asset identity, applicability, evidence, authority or gate contract.
items.decision: Define only the Factory-facing protocol and leave product-persona presentation to W64.

items.name: Promotion 通用升格

currentEvidence.claim: promotion is explicitly separated from local production and public projection

items.gap: No generic promotion record, authority, revocation or supersession API.
items.decision: W73 exposes eligible local evidence references only; sealing never auto-promotes or publishes.

items.name: Provider 边界透明

currentEvidence.claim: empty completion surfaces provider finish reason
provider and model route are explicit

items.gap: No normalized run event separates provider response, Mazz transformation, refusal, truncation, permission and acceptance.
items.decision: Capture boundary events in the run ledger before evaluation; preserve raw references without storing secrets.

items.name: Provider 或 Model 等同 Seat 或 Agent

currentEvidence.claim: identity separation is a permanent invariant

items.gap: The old conflation would destroy attribution, qualification and replacement semantics.
items.decision: Reject permanently; no compatibility alias may reintroduce it.

items.name: 表单中心或独立预览作为 Factory 主形态

currentEvidence.claim: Factory Desk is the current integrated product surface
legacy preview remains an implementation detail rather than product ownership

items.gap: Reviving the old shell would create parallel state ownership and duplicate the current Desk.
items.decision: Keep only compatibility code where proven necessary; never reopen this as a W73 product direction.

waves.name: Gap Audit and Construction Spec
waves.exitGate: All 22 recovered backlog items have one classification, one owner and repository-verifiable evidence.

waves.name: Production Run Identity and Append-only Ledger
waves.exitGate: One existing W68 production path writes and reopens a versioned local run chain without changing review behavior or requiring W66/W69/W82.

waves.name: Rework and Audit Discipline
waves.exitGate: Repair, audit flags, hallucinated anchors and resolution evidence are traceable to artifacts and survive resume.

waves.name: Qualification and Delegation
waves.exitGate: Qualification is explicit and external delegation either uses a real Harness session or reports BLOCKED without impersonation.

waves.name: Joint Scheduler and Elastic Staffing
waves.exitGate: Candidate, reason, budget, health, backpressure and manual override are recorded for every staffing decision.

waves.name: Cost, KPI and Local Evaluation
waves.exitGate: Versioned metrics recompute from runs; estimates and actuals are separate; no Overall Score or hidden routing exists.

waves.name: Director and Process Protocol Assets
waves.exitGate: Protocol assets are inspectable and consumed by the current Factory surface without a second module shell.

waves.name: Integration, Recovery and Soak
waves.exitGate: Existing W68 flows remain compatible; crash/resume/cancel and 20-cycle resource evidence pass with no orphan run, listener or executor.
